name: Triple Christmas Gold
review:
Triple Christmas Gold is a festive version of Triple Royal Gold: 3 reels, up to 27 ways, wilds, avalanches, and free spins with retriggers and a rising bet multiplier.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 5,000x cap and RTP of 96.12–96.42%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
